title: Zero Touch Devcontainer GitKraken Desktop
description: Windsurf MCP config at ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json after rebuild.
summary: Added zero-touch GitKraken Desktop onboarding by persisting GitKraken CLI workspace state in the devcontainer, installing the official gk CLI during post-create, bootstrapping the default Semio GitKraken workspace on post-attach, documenting the flow, and covering the attach bootstrap with regression tests.
